source.label: thm:expected-regret-bound
source.quote: If \cref{alg:proper-ts} satisfies $\Prob*{\sup_{\Arm\in\ArmSet_t}\Inner{\Arm,\TsSample_t}\geq\sup_{\Arm\in\ArmSet_t}\Inner{\Arm,\Param}\Given\Param,\HistoryPlus_t}\geq\OptProb$, whenever $\Norm{\Estimator_t-\Param}_{\SymCovMatrix_t^{-1}}\leq\Radius$, we then have $\Regret(T,\PolicyTS)\leq\OrderLog*{\frac{\Radius\Inflation}{\OptProb}\sqrt{\Dim T}}$.

results.notes: Regret defined with expectation including the prior (Bayesian; frequentist via point-mass prior). Conditional sufficient-condition result.

conditions: sigma != tau (true prior variance differs from noise variance)

source.label: thm:lin-ts-regret-informal
source.quote: Assume that $\Inner{\Arm,\Param}\in[-1,1]$ for all $\Arm\in\ArmSet_t$ almost surely. Then, under \cref{as:optimal-diversity,as:optimal-random-friendly}, we have $\sum_{t=1}^T\Inner{\OptimalArm_t,\Param}-\Inner{\ChosenArm_t,\Param}\leq\OrderLog{\Inflation\Dim\sqrt{T}}+2\sum_{t=1}^{T}\Indicator(\Thinness(\SymCovMatrix_t)>\ThinnessBound)$, with probability at least $1-\frac3T$, provided that ... $\Inflation\geq\frac{\DivParam\ThinnessBound}{\ExploreRatio}\cdot\OrderLog{1}$.

results.notes: Informal version; probability 1-3/T. Formal version Theorem 9.1 / Corollary 9.1.

source.quote: Let $\Worth_t(\cdot)$ be optimistic with parameter $\OptProb$ whenever $\ITypical_t=1$, $\ITypicalM_t=1$, and $\IWellPosed_t=1$.
